license_constraints: adapter itself has zero hard runtime dependency on mne/mne_bids -- it consumes lightweight BIDS metadata (JSON/TSV) and user-provided derived feature tables (CSV/JSON) with the Python standard library only; mne/mne_bids remain optional, already permissive_low (BSD-3-Clause) dependencies per external_tools/registry_seed.json if a future v2 ingests real MNE objects directly
limitations: Consumes lightweight BIDS metadata (dataset_description.json, participants.tsv, events.tsv) and explicit user-provided derived feature tables only -- does not read raw EEG/MEG/iEEG/fNIRS signal files and does not run MNE preprocessing.
Requires an explicit, human-authored mapping file declaring source_state/target_state/modality/canonical feature names/definitions; never infers state labels from column names or file paths.
Emits subject-level (record_level='subject') TransitionRecordV1 records only -- cohort-level records require real cohort statistics this v1 does not compute.
Does not itself ingest raw MNE Raw/Epochs objects, MOABB/EEGDash datasets, or live BrainFlow/MNE-LSL streams -- see docs/mne_bids_adapter.md's Future Work section.
